subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw make `append?: boolean` part of the built-in `write` tool and observable write-event/backend contract for ordinary agent, cron, and monitor workflows, including the session-admission alias adjustment in this branch?
rationale: The implementation is additive and tested, but it creates a public model-facing and extension-observable tool contract plus a session-state compatibility choice that automation should not approve without maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land after explicitly accepting `append?: boolean` and optional `appendFile` as the supported write-tool contract and accepting the admission identity behavior.

options.title: Use a separate append surface
options.body: Ask for a narrower replacement using `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool if maintainers do not want `write` to grow this responsibility.

options.title: Pause or close this API shape
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and reject this branch if docs, prompt guidance, or an exec workaround remains the preferred product direction for now.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land after explicitly accepting `append?: boolean` and optional `appendFile` as the supported write-tool contract and accepting the admission identity behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the agent runtime, model-facing tool contract, and session/gateway admission behavior reflected in recent history.
